messages:
alex: Quick check — PR #16234 (security hotfix) is green locally but CI queue is ~120 jobs deep. Deploy freeze starts tomorrow 06:00 UTC. Can we get a fast path? https://git.internal/r/redwood/inference/pull/16234

maria: What's failing in CI when it runs? any flaky test stacktrace?

alex: Only one flaky unit: tests/auth/test_token_timeout.py::test_short_timeout occasionally times out on mac matrix. Local run passes. CI log snippet:```
E   TimeoutError: Client request timed out after 10s
---
# command used:
pytest tests/auth/test_token_timeout.py -q
```

jin: Two quick options: cherry-pick the commit to the hotfix branch and do a targeted canary deploy, or rerun just the unit matrix for linux/amd64. For cherry-pick:```
git checkout hotfix/2026-03-18
git cherry-pick --no-commit <commit-hash-from-pr>
git commit -m "hotfix: token timeout fix (cherry-picked)"
git push origin hotfix/2026-03-18
```
Would preserve release cadence and avoids full matrix.

ops-bot: CI queue ETA update: current backlog ~2h30m, estimated start for new jobs ~02:40:00. Priority reruns not available via API.

lisa: Heads-up: release freeze starts 06:00 UTC; we want minimal manual interventions. If this is security-critical we can allow a hotfix lane but need process: 2 approvers + security sign-off. @paul can you take a look?

paul: I can review in ~20m. Quick scan: please add an explicit client.timeout in the HTTP wrapper — I think a missing timeout is the root cause. Small change, then I can approve. Example: ```python
client = AsyncHTTPClient(timeout=5)
```

alex: Thanks — pushed a tiny tweak (commit fa12b3d). Ran unit tests locally. Can someone trigger a unit-only job or give guidance to land to hotfix branch? Also tagging eng-infra to see if they can advise: @eng-infra-bot

eng-infra-bot: We can't fast-track single PRs for fairness, but you can: 1) open a cherry-pick PR to hotfix branch with reduced CI matrix (unit-only), 2) request manual canary via release console after merge. Use label `hotfix:unit-only` to run the trimmed pipeline.

maria: If we do unit-only and merge to hotfix, the orchestration can promote to canary. That should be safe for a timeout fix. We just need the security sign-off before we promote.

alex: Created cherry-pick PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/inference/pull/16280 -> hotfix/2026-03-18 with label `hotfix:unit-only`. Requested review from @paul and pinged @sam from security.

sam: Reviewed diffs. Change is minimal and adds a conservative timeout. Security OK to proceed for hotfix, conditional on an added unit asserting timeout <=5s (tiny test). :white_check_mark:

paul: Approved. Left one nit in test assertion, pushed suggestion comment.

alex: Addressed nit, force-pushed (commit b7c9e5a). Triggered unit-only pipeline via label.

ops-bot: Unit-only pipeline completed: all unit jobs green. Full matrix still queued.

lisa: With approvals (paul) and security sign-off (sam), I approve hotfix lane. Proceed to merge to hotfix branch and request manual canary deploy. Please document the rollback plan in the PR description.

alex: Merged to hotfix/2026-03-18 and requested canary deploy. PR #16234 closed. Monitoring canary now, will post updates. Thanks all :tada:

maria: Thanks — will watch metrics and paging for next hour.

alex: FYI if the canary looks good we'll promote after 30m, otherwise revert and open follow-up.

eng-infra-bot: Canary deploy initiated. Canary window: 30m.

alex: Noted. Closing thread unless there are objections.

lisa: No objections. Great coordination. :clap:
